lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Application or project: applications and interviews

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic applications and interviews task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The fictional Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar is hiring a part-time crew member.
safetyNotes: The mock interview is private practice within the household with a willing, available adult or peer, never a real employer, and is never performed publicly or recorded.
Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar and Jordan Whitfield are entirely fictional; no real application is submitted anywhere.

simulationAlternative.description: If no partner is available for a live practice interview, write out both a set of five interview questions and your own answers to each instead.

materials: learner-local: the fictional job posting on this task sheet
learner-local: the interviewer script on this task sheet

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Which of the three questions was hardest to answer out loud, and what would you change about your answer if you could redo it?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Application completeness and privacy: The application includes only first name, genuine interests, and realistic availability, with nothing else added. | Interview delivery: All three questions receive a spoken answer with at least one concrete detail, and the learner asks one relevant question back. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write two follow-up questions Jordan Whitfield might realistically ask after their answers, and practice responding to those on the spot with their partner.

resources.title: applications and interviews worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The fictional Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar is hiring a part-time crew member.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact applications and interviews decision or action.
Model move 2: Read the fictional Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar job posting on this task sheet before filling out anything.
Model move 3: Fill out the short fictional application: your first name, two or three genuine interests, and realistic weekly availability.

Model check: Application completeness and privacy: The application includes only first name, genuine interests, and realistic availability, with nothing else added. | Interview delivery: All three questions receive a spoken answer with at least one concrete detail, and the learner asks one relevant question back.

resources.title: applications and interviews action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for applications and interviews.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: applications and interviews coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The fictional Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar is hiring a part-time crew member.
Coach direction: Read the fictional Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar job posting on this task sheet before filling out anything.
Learner prompt: Name two things about this fictional role that connect to your own real interests or past responsibilities.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: applications and interviews complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Fill out the short fictional application: your first name, two or three genuine interests, and realistic weekly availability. Do not write a real address, real ID number, or any information beyond what is asked for.
Response 1 (t2-p1): My application lists only my first name, interests, and availability, with no address, phone number, or ID number of any kind.
Response 2 (t2-p2): Write the availability section of your application: which days and roughly which hours you'd realistically be free for a fictional part-time shift.
Equal-access rule: If no partner is available for a live practice interview, write out both a set of five interview questions and your own answers to each instead.

resources.title: applications and interviews minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Which of the three questions was hardest to answer out loud, and what would you change about your answer if you could redo it?

Success checks: Application completeness and privacy: The application includes only first name, genuine interests, and realistic availability, with nothing else added. | Interview delivery: All three questions receive a spoken answer with at least one concrete detail, and the learner asks one relevant question back.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: applications and interviews supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional applications and interviews condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Application completeness and privacy: The application includes only first name, genuine interests, and realistic availability, with nothing else added. | Interview delivery: All three questions receive a spoken answer with at least one concrete detail, and the learner asks one relevant question back..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: The fictional Cedar Lane Smoothie Bar is hiring a part-time crew member.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: Name two things about this fictional role that connect to your own real interests or past responsibilities.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.
guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Application completeness and privacy: The application includes only first name, genuine interests, and realistic availability, with nothing else added.

realRoute.title: applications and interviews — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Use only a safe, permitted setting and the materials already available to you.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.

Fill out the short fictional application: your first name, two or three genuine interests, and realistic weekly availability. Do not write a real address, real ID number, or any information beyond what is asked for.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record and the completed application responses.

simulationRoute.title: applications and interviews — complete fictional route

simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Application completeness and privacy: The application includes only first name, genuine interests, and realistic availability, with nothing else added. | Interview delivery: All three questions receive a spoken answer with at least one concrete detail, and the learner asks one relevant question back.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
